title: Intention — the root of the journey
body: What we want to be the case. An HQDM `plan`: a possible world that a party intends. Intention is prior to requirement — we know our intention even before we understand our requirements, so it is the seed the requirements decompose. Every requirement is `part_of_plan` of an intention.

title: The intended world
body: A plain statement of the state of affairs we intend. It is held with confidence even while the requirements that specify it are still unclear; the journey exists to turn this into checkable requirements, committed decisions, and realizing activities.

title: Requirements derived
body: How many requirements decompose this intention (a rollup over the intention → requirements relation). Growth here is the intention becoming understood.

title: From intention
body: The intention this requirement specifies part of — grounded as HQDM `part_of_plan`. A requirement with no intention is unanchored: it specifies a plan nobody declared.

title: Intention → Requirements
body: Each requirement names the intention it decomposes; this seam is the first of the journey (Intention → Requirement → Decision), grounded as plan → requirement_specification → agreement.
